narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On March 12, 2024, at approximately 0905 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at the Kalamazoo County courthouse after a referral from a probation officer. Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] explained who he was and asked about the subject's citizenship.
The subject stated that he is a citizen of Honduras.
He explained that he left Choluteca in October 2015 and traveled through Guatemala and Mexico by bus and freight train.
He said he crossed the Rio Grande on an inner tube near Brownsville, Texas, on the night of 11/14/2015, and that agents never stopped him.
He has lived in Michigan since 2016.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Warrant of Arrest and Notice to Appear.
